Verses.VerseEn: Alif, Lam, Mim. (Only Allah and the Messenger [blessings and peace be upon him] know the real meaning.)

Verses.VerseAr: اَحَسِبَ النَّاسُ اَنۡ يُّتۡرَكُوۡۤا اَنۡ يَّقُوۡلُوۡۤا اٰمَنَّا وَهُمۡ لَا يُفۡتَـنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Do people think that they will be released (just) on saying: ‘We have believed,’and they will not be tried?

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ فَتَـنَّا الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡ‌ فَلَيَـعۡلَمَنَّ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡنَ صَدَقُوۡا وَلَيَعۡلَمَنَّ الۡكٰذِبِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely We tried (also) those who were before them. Certainly Allah shall make them prominent (through trial) who are truthful (in claiming belief), and shall make known the liars (as well).

Words.MeaningEn: And Allah will surely make evident
And Allah will surely make evident
and He will surely make evident

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ حَسِبَ الَّذِيۡنَ يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ السَّيِّاٰتِ اَنۡ يَّسۡبِقُوۡنَا‌ؕ سَآءَ مَا يَحۡكُمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Do the evildoers think that they will slip away from Our (grip)? How evil is what they decide (in their minds)!

Verses.VerseAr: مَنۡ كَانَ يَرۡجُوۡا لِقَآءَ اللّٰهِ فَاِنَّ اَجَلَ اللّٰهِ لَاٰتٍ‌ؕ وَهُوَ السَّمِيۡعُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Whoever hopes for meeting with Allah, then Allah’s appointed time is bound to come. And He alone is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَنۡ جَاهَدَ فَاِنَّمَا يُجَاهِدُ لِنَفۡسِهٖؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَـغَنِىٌّ عَنِ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Whoever strives hard (for the cause of Truth) strives for his own (benefit). Surely Allah is independent of (the obedience, submission, toils and struggles) of all the worlds.

Verses.VerseAr: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَـنُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنۡهُمۡ سَيِّاٰتِهِمۡ وَلَـنَجۡزِيَنَّهُمۡ اَحۡسَنَ الَّذِىۡ كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And those who believe and do pious deeds, We shall remove all their misdeeds from their (record) and shall certainly give them reward better than the deeds which they will have (actually) accomplished.

Words.MeaningEn: and We will surely reward them

Verses.VerseAr: وَوَصَّيۡنَا الۡاِنۡسَانَ بِوَالِدَيۡهِ حُسۡنًا‌ؕ وَّاِنۡ جَاهَدٰكَ لِتُشۡرِكَ بِىۡ مَا لَـيۡسَ لَـكَ بِهٖ عِلۡمٌ فَلَا تُطِعۡهُمَاؕ اِلَىَّ مَرۡجِعُكُمۡ فَاُنَبِّئُكُمۡ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We have enjoined upon man to behave benevolently with his parents. And if they struggle with you to make you associate with Me what you have no knowledge of, then do not obey them. To Me you (all) have to return. So I shall inform you of (the deeds) which you used to do (in the world).

Verses.VerseAr: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوۡا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَـنُدۡخِلَـنَّهُمۡ فِىۡ الصّٰلِحِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And those who believe and do pious deeds then We shall certainly admit them to the (group) of the most pious.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنۡ يَّقُوۡلُ اٰمَنَّا بِاللّٰهِ فَاِذَاۤ اُوۡذِىَ فِىۡ اللّٰهِ جَعَلَ فِتۡنَةَ النَّاسِ كَعَذَابِ اللّٰهِؕ وَلَٮِٕنۡ جَآءَ نَـصۡرٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكَ لَيَـقُوۡلُنَّ اِنَّا كُنَّا مَعَكُمۡ‌ؕ اَوَلَـيۡسَ اللّٰهُ بِاَعۡلَمَ بِمَا فِىۡ صُدُوۡرِ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And there are (also) those among the people who (verbally) say: ‘We believe in Allah,’ but when they are put to (some) trouble in the way of Allah, they consider the trial of the people not unlike punishment from Allah. And if some help comes from your Lord, then indeed they start saying: ‘We were with you.’ Is Allah not best aware of those (things) which are (hidden) in the breasts of all the people of the world?

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَيَـعۡلَمَنَّ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَلَيَـعۡلَمَنَّ الۡمُنٰفِقِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely Allah will distinguish those who have believed (with true hearts) and will certainly expose the hypocrites (too).

Words.MeaningEn: And Allah will surely make evident
And Allah will surely make evident
And He will surely make evident

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لِلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا اتَّبِعُوۡا سَبِيۡلَـنَا وَلۡـنَحۡمِلۡ خَطٰيٰكُمۡؕ وَمَا هُمۡ بِحٰمِلِيۡنَ مِنۡ خَطٰيٰهُمۡ مِّنۡ شَىۡءٍ‌ؕ اِنَّهُمۡ لَـكٰذِبُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the disbelievers say to the believers: ‘Follow our way and we shall bear (the burden of) your sins,’ whereas they will not bear any (burden) of their sins. Surely they are liars.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَيَحۡمِلُنَّ اَثۡقَالَهُمۡ وَاَثۡقَالاً مَّعَ اَثۡقَالِهِمۡ‌ وَلَـيُسۡـَٔـلُنَّ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ عَمَّا كَانُوۡا يَفۡتَرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They will certainly carry their own burdens (of sins) and (will also have loaded) many (other) burdens (over themselves) along with their own burdens. And they will certainly be interrogated on the Day of Resurrection about those (false allegations) which they used to invent.

Words.MeaningEn: and surely they will be questioned

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوۡحًا اِلٰى قَوۡمِهٖ فَلَبِثَ فِيۡهِمۡ اَلۡفَ سَنَةٍ اِلَّا خَمۡسِيۡنَ عَامًاؕ فَاَخَذَهُمُ الطُّوۡفَانُ وَهُمۡ ظٰلِمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And indeed We sent Nuh (Noah) to his people. He lived among them for a millennium less fifty years. Then the Great Flood (Deluge) seized them while they were wrongdoers.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَنۡجَيۡنٰهُ وَاَصۡحٰبَ السَّفِيۡنَةِ وَجَعَلۡنٰهَاۤ اٰيَةً لِّـلۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then We delivered Nuh (Noah) and those (with him) in the Ark, and made that (Ark and the incident) a Sign for the people of the world.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ اِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهِ اعۡبُدُوۡا اللّٰهَ وَاتَّقُوۡهُ‌ؕ ذٰلِكُمۡ خَيۡرٌ لَّـكُمۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (remember) Ibrahim (Abraham) when he said to his people: ‘Worship Allah and fear Him. That is better for you if you know (the reality).

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّمَا تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اَوۡثَانًا وَّتَخۡلُقُوۡنَ اِفۡكًا‌ؕ اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ لَا يَمۡلِكُوۡنَ لَـكُمۡ رِزۡقًا فَابۡتَغُوۡا عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ الرِّزۡقَ وَاعۡبُدُوۡهُ وَاشۡكُرُوۡا لَهٗؕ اِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: You worship idols besides Allah and fabricate mere lies. Surely those you worship instead of Allah are not masters of your sustenance. So always seek sustenance from Allah, and worship Him alone, and submit thanks to Him. You will be returned to Him alone.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنۡ تُكَذِّبُوۡا فَقَدۡ كَذَّبَ اُمَمٌ مِّنۡ قَبۡلِكُمۡ‌ؕ وَمَا عَلَى الرَّسُوۡلِ اِلَّا الۡبَلٰغُ الۡمُبِيۡنُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And if you reject (my words) then no doubt many generations have rejected (the Truth) before as well. And nothing is (obligatory) upon the Messenger but to convey (the Commandments) in a clear way.’

Verses.VerseAr: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا كَيۡفَ يُبۡدِئُ اللّٰهُ الۡخَـلۡقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيۡدُهٗؕ اِنَّ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ يَسِيۡرٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have they not seen (i.e. pondered) how Allah originates creation, then repeats it (the same way)? Surely this (work) is easy for Allah.

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ سِيۡرُوۡا فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ فَانْظُرُوۡا كَيۡفَ بَدَاَ الۡخَـلۡقَ‌ ثُمَّ اللّٰهُ يُنۡشِئُ النَّشۡاَةَ الۡاٰخِرَةَ‌ ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَىۡءٍ قَدِيۡرٌ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘Travel in the land (to study life in the universe), then observe (i.e. meditate and research) as to how He initiated (life of) Creation and how He raises and nourishes second life (passing it through evolutionary stages). Surely Allah has Perfect Power over all things.

Verses.VerseAr: يُعَذِّبُ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ وَيَرۡحَمُ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ‌ۚ وَاِلَيۡهِ تُقۡلَبُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He torments whom He wills and shows Mercy to whom He pleases. And to Him will you be returned.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَاۤ اَنۡـتُمۡ بِمُعۡجِزِيۡنَ فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَا فِىۡ السَّمَآءِ‌ وَمَا لَـكُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ مِنۡ وَّلِىٍّ وَّلَا نَصِيۡرٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And you can escape (from Allah) neither in the earth nor in the heavens, and nor is there for you any guardian or helper except Allah.

Verses.VerseAr: وَالَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَلِقَآٮِٕهٖۤ اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ يَٮِٕسُوۡا مِنۡ رَّحۡمَتِىۡ وَاُولٰٓٮِٕكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And those who reject Allah’s Revelations and deny meeting with Him, they despair of My Mercy. And it is they for whom there is painful punishment.

Verses.VerseAr: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوۡمِهٖۤ اِلَّاۤ اَنۡ قَالُوۡا اقۡتُلُوۡهُ اَوۡ حَرِّقُوۡهُ فَاَنۡجٰٮهُ اللّٰهُ مِنَ النَّارِ‌ؕ اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاَيٰتٍ لِّقَوۡمٍ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So the People of Ibrahim (Abraham) had no answer except that they said: ‘Kill him or burn him.’ Then Allah delivered him from the fire (of Nimrod). Surely there are Signs in this incident for those who have believed.

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالَ اِنَّمَا اتَّخَذۡتُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اَوۡثَانًا ۙ مَّوَدَّةَ بَيۡنِكُمۡ فِىۡ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا‌ۚ ثُمَّ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ يَكۡفُرُ بَعۡضُكُمۡ بِبَعۡضٍ وَّيَلۡعَنُ بَعۡضُكُمۡ بَعۡضًا وَّمَاۡوٰٮكُمُ النَّارُ وَمَا لَـكُمۡ مِّنۡ نّٰصِرِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Ibrahim (Abraham) said: ‘You have taken up the worship of idols leaving Allah merely for the sake of mutual friendship in the life of this world. Then on the Day of Resurrection (each) one of you will deny (the friendship of) the other and (each) one of you will curse the other. Hell is your abode and there will be no helper for you.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاٰمَنَ لَهٗ لُوۡطٌ‌ۘ وَقَالَ اِنِّىۡ مُهَاجِرٌ اِلٰى رَبِّىۡؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡحَكِيۡمُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then Lut (Lot) believed in him (Ibrahim [Abraham]) and he said: ‘I am migrating towards my Lord. Surely He is Almighty, Most Wise.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهٗۤ اِسۡحٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوۡبَ وَجَعَلۡنَا فِىۡ ذُرِّيَّتِهِ النُّبُوَّةَ وَالۡكِتٰبَ وَاٰتَيۡنٰهُ اَجۡرَهٗ فِىۡ الدُّنۡيَا‌ۚ وَاِنَّهٗ فِىۡ الۡاٰخِرَةِ لَمِنَ الصّٰلِحِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We blessed him with Ishaq (Isaac) and Ya‘qub ([Jacob] a son and a grandson) and We ordained Prophethood and the Book in Ibrahim’s descendants. And We gave him his reward (here) in this world and surely he is among the most pious in the Hereafter (as well).

Verses.VerseAr: وَلُوۡطًا اِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهٖۤ اِنَّكُمۡ لَـتَاۡتُوۡنَ الۡفَاحِشَةَ مَا سَبَـقَكُمۡ بِهَا مِنۡ اَحَدٍ مِّنَ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (remember) Lut (Lot) when he said to his people: ‘Surely you commit the worst indecency. None of the nations in the whole world has ever committed this (indecency) before you.

Verses.VerseAr: اَٮِٕنَّكُمۡ لَـتَاۡتُوۡنَ الرِّجَالَ وَتَقۡطَعُوۡنَ السَّبِيۡلَۙ وَتَاۡتُوۡنَ فِىۡ نَادِيۡكُمُ الۡمُنۡكَرَ‌ؕ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوۡمِهٖۤ اِلَّاۤ اَنۡ قَالُوۡا ائۡتِنَا بِعَذَابِ اللّٰهِ اِنۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Do you approach men (for your sexual desire) and commit highway robberies and do indecent deeds in your (crowded) meetings?’ And his people (also) had no answer except that they said: ‘Bring upon us Allah’s torment if you are truthful.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ رَبِّ انْصُرۡنِىۡ عَلَى الۡقَوۡمِ الۡمُفۡسِدِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Lut (Lot) submitted: ‘O Lord! Help me against the mischief mongers.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡ رُسُلُنَاۤ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ بِالۡبُشۡرٰىۙ قَالُـوۡۤا اِنَّا مُهۡلِكُوۡۤا اَهۡلِ هٰذِهِ الۡقَرۡيَةِ‌ۚ اِنَّ اَهۡلَهَا كَانُوۡا ظٰلِمِيۡنَ‌ ۖ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when Our messengers (angels) came to Ibrahim (Abraham) with good news (then, adding) they (also) said: ‘We are going to destroy the dwellers of this town because its inhabitants are the wrongdoers.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ اِنَّ فِيۡهَا لُوۡطًا‌ؕ قَالُوۡا نَحۡنُ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَنۡ فِيۡهَا‌ لَـنُـنَجِّيَنَّهٗ وَاَهۡلَهٗۤ اِلَّا امۡرَاَتَهٗ كَانَتۡ مِنَ الۡغٰبِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Ibrahim (Abraham) said: ‘Lut (Lot) is (also) here in this (town).’ They said: ‘We know very well the people who (live) in it. We shall certainly save Lut (Lot) and his family except his wife. She is of those who remain behind.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَمَّاۤ اَنۡ جَآءَتۡ رُسُلُـنَا لُوۡطًا سِىۡٓءَ بِهِمۡ وَضَاقَ بِهِمۡ ذَرۡعًا وَّقَالُوۡا لَا تَخَفۡ وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ‌ اِنَّا مُنَجُّوۡكَ وَاَهۡلَكَ اِلَّا امۡرَاَتَكَ كَانَتۡ مِنَ الۡغٰبِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when Our messengers (angels) came to Lut (Lot), he felt distressed (on their arrival) and felt depressed for their (intention to torment). And (the messengers) said: ‘Do not feel afraid or grieved. We shall no doubt save you and your family except your wife. She is of those who will remain behind (for torment).

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّا مُنۡزِلُوۡنَ عَلٰٓى اَهۡلِ هٰذِهِ الۡقَرۡيَةِ رِجۡزًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَفۡسُقُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely we are about to bring down from the heaven torment for the inhabitants of this town because they used to disobey.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَد تَّرَكۡنَا مِنۡهَاۤ اٰيَةًۢ بَيِّنَةً لِّـقَوۡمٍ يَّعۡقِلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And verily We sustained (the ruined houses) of this town as a clear Sign for the wise.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِلٰى مَدۡيَنَ اَخَاهُمۡ شُعَيۡبًاۙ فَقَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اعۡبُدُوۡا اللّٰهَ وَارۡجُوۡا الۡيَوۡمَ الۡاٰخِرَ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡا فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (We sent) to Madyan their (kinship) brother Shu‘aib. So he said: ‘O my people, worship Allah and look forward to the Last Day and do not do mischief in the land.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَكَذَّبُوۡهُ فَاَخَذَتۡهُمُ الرَّجۡفَةُ فَاَصۡبَحُوۡا فِىۡ دَارِهِمۡ جٰثِمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then they rejected Shu‘aib. So (the torment of) earthquake seized them (as well) and at dawn they were lying prone in their houses (dead).

Verses.VerseAr: وَعَادًا وَّثَمُوۡدَا۟ وَقَدْ تَّبَيَّنَ لَـكُمۡ مِّنۡ مَّسٰكِنِهِمۡ‌ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيۡطٰنُ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ فَصَدَّهُمۡ عَنِ السَّبِيۡلِ وَكَانُوۡا مُسۡتَـبۡصِرِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (We destroyed) ‘Ad and Thamud (as well). And indeed (ruins of) some of their houses stand out (have lived to tell the tale) for you (as a lesson of warning). And Satan made their evil deeds look charming to them and turned them away from the path (of Truth) though they were vigilant and wise.

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَارُوۡنَ وَفِرۡعَوۡنَ وَهَامٰنَ‌ وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُمۡ مُّوۡسٰى بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ فَاسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡا فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا كَانُوۡا سٰبِقِيۡنَ ‌ۖ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (We also destroyed) Qarun (Korah), Pharaoh and Haman. And surely Musa (Moses) brought to them clear Signs and they were arrogant and violent in the land but could not escape (Our seizure).

Verses.VerseAr: فَكُلاًّ اَخَذۡنَا بِذَنۡۢبِهٖ‌ۚ فَمِنۡهُمۡ مَّنۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ حَاصِبًا‌ۚ وَمِنۡهُمۡ مَّنۡ اَخَذَتۡهُ الصَّيۡحَةُ‌ ۚ وَمِنۡهُمۡ مَّنۡ خَسَفۡنَا بِهِ الۡاَرۡضَ‌ۚ وَمِنۡهُمۡ مَّنۡ اَغۡرَقۡنَا‌ۚ وَمَا كَانَ اللّٰهُ لِيَظۡلِمَهُمۡ وَلٰـكِنۡ كَانُوۡۤا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So We seized (everyone of) them for his sin. And there was (a faction) of those against whom We sent a storm of pelting stones. And of them was (also a group) whom a roaring blast seized. And (a party) of them were such whom We sank into the earth. And of them there was (yet another community) that We drowned. And Allah would never have wronged them, but they themselves wronged their own souls.

Verses.VerseAr: مَثَلُ الَّذِيۡنَ اتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اَوۡلِيَآءَ كَمَثَلِ الۡعَنۡكَبُوۡتِ ‌ۖۚ اتَّخَذَتۡ بَيۡتًا‌ؕ وَاِنَّ اَوۡهَنَ الۡبُيُوۡتِ لَبَيۡتُ الۡعَنۡكَبُوۡتِ‌ۘ لَوۡ كَانُوۡا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The example of those (disbelievers) who have taken others (i.e. idols) as guardians instead of Allah is like the story of a spider who builds (for herself) a house (of cobweb). And no doubt the weakest of all houses is the spider’s house. Would that they knew it!

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ مِنۡ شَىۡءٍ‌ؕ وَهُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡحَكِيۡمُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely Allah knows (the truth of the idols) that they worship instead of Him and He alone is Almighty, Most Wise.

Verses.VerseAr: وَتِلۡكَ الۡاَمۡثَالُ نَضۡرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ‌ۚ وَمَا يَعۡقِلُهَاۤ اِلَّا الۡعٰلِمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And these are the examples which We explain for the people (to understand), and none understands them except those who have knowledge.

Verses.VerseAr: خَلَقَ اللّٰهُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ بِالۡحَـقِّ‌ؕ اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاَيَةً لِّـلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Allah has created the heavens and the earth with a zero-defect strategy. Surely there is in this (Creation) a Sign (of His Oneness and Might) for those who believe.

Verses.VerseAr: اُتۡلُ مَاۤ اُوۡحِىَ اِلَيۡكَ مِنَ الۡكِتٰبِ وَاَقِمِ الصَّلٰوةَ   ‌ؕ اِنَّ الصَّلٰوةَ تَنۡهٰى عَنِ الۡفَحۡشَآءِ وَالۡمُنۡكَرِ‌ؕ وَلَذِكۡرُ اللّٰهِ اَكۡبَرُ  ‌ؕ وَاللّٰهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تَصۡنَعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (O Esteemed Beloved!) Recite that Book which has been revealed to you and establish Prayer. Surely Prayer prohibits indecency and impiety; and verily the remembrance of Allah is the greatest. And Allah knows whatever (deeds) you do.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَا تُجَادِلُوۡٓا اَهۡلَ الۡكِتٰبِ اِلَّا بِالَّتِىۡ هِىَ اَحۡسَنُ  ۖ اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا مِنۡهُمۡ‌ وَقُوۡلُوۡٓا اٰمَنَّا بِالَّذِىۡۤ اُنۡزِلَ اِلَيۡنَا وَاُنۡزِلَ اِلَيۡكُمۡ وَاِلٰهُـنَا وَاِلٰهُكُمۡ وَاحِدٌ وَّنَحۡنُ لَهٗ مُسۡلِمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, (O Believers,) do not argue with the People of the Book but in a suitable and decent way, except those of them who did injustice. And say (to them): ‘We believe in that (Book) which has been revealed to us and which was sent down to you and our God and your God is but One and we obey Him alone.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَكَذٰلِكَ اَنۡزَلۡنَاۤ اِلَيۡكَ الۡكِتٰبَ‌ؕ فَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰتَيۡنٰهُمُ الۡكِتٰبَ يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِهٖ‌ۚ وَمِنۡ هٰٓؤُلَاۤءِ مَنۡ يُّؤۡمِنُ بِهٖ ‌ؕ وَمَا يَجۡحَدُ بِاٰيٰتِنَاۤ اِلَّا الۡكٰفِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And in like manner We revealed the Book to you. And those (gnostics of the Truth) whom We had given the Book (already) believe in this (Book). And of these (inhabitants of Makka too) there are those who believe in it. And none but the disbelievers deny Our Revelations.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا كُنۡتَ تَـتۡلُوۡا مِنۡ قَبۡلِهٖ مِنۡ كِتٰبٍ وَّلَا تَخُطُّهٗ بِيَمِيۡنِكَ‌ اِذًا لَّارۡتَابَ الۡمُبۡطِلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, (O Beloved,) you never recited any book before this, nor did you write it with your own hand in which case the disbelievers would certainly have doubted.

Verses.VerseAr: بَلۡ هُوَ اٰيٰتٌۢ بَيِّنٰتٌ فِىۡ صُدُوۡرِ الَّذِيۡنَ اُوۡتُوۡا الۡعِلۡمَ‌ؕ وَمَا يَجۡحَدُ بِاٰيٰتِنَاۤ اِلَّا الظّٰلِمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: But these are the clear verses (of the Qur’an) that are (preserved) in the breasts of those who have been given (true) knowledge. And none other than the unjust deny Our Revelations.

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالُوۡا لَوۡلَاۤ اُنۡزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ اٰيٰتٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّهٖ‌ؕ قُلۡ اِنَّمَا الۡاٰيٰتُ عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ ؕ وَاِنَّمَاۤ اَنَا۟ نَذِيۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the disbelievers say: ‘Why have Signs not been sent down on him (the Holy Prophet [blessings and peace be upon him]) from his Lord?’ Say: ‘The Signs are with Allah alone and I am simply an open Warner.’

Verses.VerseAr: اَوَلَمۡ يَكۡفِهِمۡ اَنَّاۤ اَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ الۡكِتٰبَ يُتۡلٰى عَلَيۡهِمۡ‌ؕ اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَرَحۡمَةً وَّذِكۡرٰى لِقَوۡمٍ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Is this (Sign) not enough for them that We have revealed to you (that) Book which is recited to them (or will always be recited)? Surely in this (Book) there is mercy and direction and guidance for the believers.

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ كَفٰى بِاللّٰهِ بَيۡنِىۡ وَبَيۡنَكُمۡ شَهِيۡدًا ‌ۚ يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِىۡ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ‌ؕ وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُۡا بِالۡبَاطِلِ وَكَفَرُوۡا بِاللّٰهِۙ اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ هُمُ الۡخٰسِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘Sufficient is Allah as a Witness between me and you. He knows (the state of) all that is in the heavens and in the earth. And those who believe in falsehood and disbelieve in Allah, it is they who are the losers.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَسۡتَعۡجِلُوۡنَكَ بِالۡعَذَابِ‌ؕ وَلَوۡلَاۤ اَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى لَّجَآءَهُمُ الۡعَذَابُؕ وَلَيَاۡتِيَنَّهُمۡ بَغۡتَةً وَّهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they want you to hasten the torment. And had the time (of the torment) not been fixed, the torment would have overtaken them. And that (torment, or the time of the torment,) shall certainly come upon them all of a sudden and they will not be aware (of it).

Words.MeaningEn: And they ask you to hasten
But it will surely come to them

Verses.VerseAr: يَسۡتَعۡجِلُوۡنَكَ بِالۡعَذَابِؕ وَاِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمُحِيۡطَةٌ  ۢ بِالۡكٰفِرِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They seek the torment from you in haste and surely Hell is about to besiege the disbelievers.

Verses.VerseAr: يَوۡمَ يَغۡشٰٮهُمُ الۡعَذَابُ مِنۡ فَوۡقِهِمۡ وَمِنۡ تَحۡتِ اَرۡجُلِهِمۡ وَيَقُوۡلُ ذُوۡقُوۡا مَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The Day when the torment wraps them from above them and from beneath their feet Allah will say: ‘Savour the taste of works you used to perform.’

Verses.VerseAr: يٰعِبَادِىَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡۤا اِنَّ اَرۡضِىۡ وَاسِعَةٌ فَاِيّٰاىَ فَاعۡبُدُوۡنِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: O My servants who have believed! Surely My earth is vast, so worship Me alone.

Verses.VerseAr: كُلُّ نَفۡسٍ ذَآٮِٕقَةُ الۡمَوۡتِ ثُمَّ اِلَيۡنَا تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Every soul is to taste death and then to Us you shall be returned.

Verses.VerseAr: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوۡا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡجَـنَّةِ غُرَفًا تَجۡرِىۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَا‌ؕ نِعۡمَ اَجۡرُ الۡعٰمِلِيۡنَ‌ۖ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And those who believe and persevere with right actions We shall certainly house them in the upper palaces of Paradise with streams flowing beneath them; they will live there forever. What an excellent reward for those who do (constructive) works!

Words.MeaningEn: surely We will give them a place

Verses.VerseAr: الَّذِيۡنَ صَبَرُوۡا وَعَلٰى رَبِّهِمۡ يَتَوَكَّلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (These are the people) who remain steadfast and always trust their Lord alone.

Verses.VerseAr: وَكَاَيِّنۡ مِّنۡ دَآبَّةٍ لَّا تَحۡمِلُ رِزۡقَهَا    ۖ اللّٰهُ يَرۡزُقُهَا وَاِيَّاكُمۡ‌‌ۖ وَهُوَ السَّمِيۡعُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And many an animal there is that does not carry its sustenance (with it)! Allah provides for them and for you too. And He is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَٮِٕنۡ سَاَلۡتَهُمۡ مَّنۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمۡسَ وَالۡقَمَرَ لَيَقُوۡلُنَّ اللّٰهُ‌ۚ فَاَنّٰى يُؤۡفَكُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And if you ask these (disbelievers): ‘Who created the heavens and the earth and made the sun and the moon law-abiding?’ they shall certainly say: ‘Allah.’ Then where are they turning away?

Verses.VerseAr: اللّٰهُ يَبۡسُطُ الرِّزۡقَ لِمَنۡ يَّشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهٖ وَيَقۡدِرُ لَهٗ ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ بِكُلِّ شَىۡءٍ عَلِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Allah increases sustenance for whom He pleases of His servants and restrains for whom He wills. Surely Allah knows everything full well.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَٮِٕنۡ سَاَلۡتَهُمۡ مَّنۡ نَّزَّلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَاَحۡيَا بِهِ الۡاَرۡضَ مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِ مَوۡتِهَا لَيَقُوۡلُنَّ اللّٰهُ‌ؕ قُلِ الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ‌ؕ بَلۡ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡقِلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And if you ask them: ‘Who sends down water from the sky, then gives life (and freshness) to the earth after its death?’ they will surely say: ‘Allah.’ Say: ‘All praise belongs to Allah alone.’ But most of them do not have sense.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا هٰذِهِ الۡحَيٰوةُ الدُّنۡيَاۤ اِلَّا لَهۡوٌ وَّلَعِبٌ‌ؕ وَاِنَّ الدَّارَ الۡاٰخِرَةَ لَهِىَ الۡحَـيَوَانُ‌ۘ لَوۡ كَانُوۡا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, (O people,) the life of this world is nothing but sport and pastime and the Home of the Hereafter is the only (true) life. Would that they knew (this secret)!

Verses.VerseAr: فَاِذَا رَكِبُوۡا فِىۡ الۡفُلۡكِ دَعَوُا اللّٰهَ مُخۡلِصِيۡنَ لَـهُ الدِّيۡنَۚ فَلَمَّا نَجّٰٮهُمۡ اِلَى الۡبَرِّ اِذَا هُمۡ يُشۡرِكُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: When they board a vessel they (abandon the idols in hard time and) call upon Allah alone, making their Din (faith and devotion) sincerely (and purely) for Him. Then, when Allah rescues and brings them safe to the land, they start setting up partners with Him (again),

Verses.VerseAr: لِيَكۡفُرُوۡا بِمَاۤ اٰتَيۡنٰهُمۡ  ۙۚ وَلِيَتَمَتَّعُوۡا‌ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So that they may show ingratitude towards that (favour of deliverance) which We granted them and enjoy (the unlawful) benefits (of the life of disbelief). But soon they shall know (their fate).

Verses.VerseAr: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اَنَّا جَعَلۡنَا حَرَمًا اٰمِنًا وَّيُتَخَطَّفُ النَّاسُ مِنۡ حَوۡلِهِمۡ‌ؕ اَفَبِالۡبَاطِلِ يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ وَبِنِعۡمَةِ اللّٰهِ يَكۡفُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And have they not seen that We have made the Sanctuary (of the Ka‘ba) a safe haven while people are abducted from all around them? Do they (still) believe in falsehood and will they continue disregarding the favour of Allah?

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَنۡ اَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنِ افۡتَرٰى عَلَى اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا اَوۡ كَذَّبَ بِالۡحَـقِّ لَـمَّا جَآءَهٗ‌ؕ اَلَيۡسَ فِىۡ جَهَـنَّمَ مَثۡوًى لِّلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And who can be more unjust than someone who fabricates a lie concerning Allah or belies the Truth when it comes to him? Is there not an apartment in Hell (appointed) for the disbelievers?

Verses.VerseAr: وَالَّذِيۡنَ جَاهَدُوۡا فِيۡنَا لَنَهۡدِيَنَّهُمۡ سُبُلَنَا ‌ؕ وَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَمَعَ الۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And those who toil hard (and fight the lower self vehemently) for Our cause We certainly guide them in Our Ways (of striving for and attaining to the gnosis — sayr and wusul), and verily Allah blesses the men of spiritual excellence with His companionship.
